newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-June industrial output up 11.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-June industrial output up 11.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's industrial output rose 11.6 percent year-on-year in the first half of 1997, the State Statistical Bureau said on Wednesday.
The bureau gave no figure for June alone.
It previously said industrial output for the first five months of the year was 11.5 percent.
The bureau said that in the January to June period, the industrial output total reached 984.9 billion yuan ($118.66 billion).
Output of state enterprises showed an increase of 5.5 percent while output of collectives rose 12.5 percent and that of private industry grew 15.1 percent.
Light industrial output climbed 12.1 percent during the six-month period while heavy industry showed a rise of 11.2 percent.

In the light industrial sector, production of colour televisions, washing machines, refrigerators and air-conditioners showed relatively fast growth, rising by a range of 14.7 percent to 27 percent during the first half.

In the heavy industrial sector, steel, iron and non-ferrous metals output increasing by a range of 5.6 percent to 15.1 percent while petrochemicals rose in a range of 6.7 percent to 28.1 percent. It gave no specific breakdown of the products within the category.
The bureau also said that state industry managed to stem some of its losses in April and May and recorded a net profit of 6.0 billion yuan in the two-month period.
It gave no figure for profits or losses of state industry the first half of the year and it cautioned that the improvement was just a first step on the road to recovery.
Unpaid debts of state enterprises continued to be a problem and had actually shown an increase, it said without elaborating. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
